title: Savannah Sands Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: An incredible beachfront home in Seaside on 2 beachfront lots with the most amazing 360-degree panoramic gulf and Seaside town views. Incredible porches & expansive open-air rooftop deck!
description_expanded: DescriptionBeachfront at 2376 East County Hwy. 30AKING, QUEEN, 2 TWINSBeachfront Luxury in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Savannah Sands, a luxury beachfront retreat perfectly positioned along Seaside’s pristine private beaches. Situated on two rare beachside lots, this exceptional home offers breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views of the Gulf, iconic Seaside townscape, and unforgettable sunsets. Recently refreshed with designer furnishings and updated kitchens and bathrooms, Savannah Sands delivers an elevated coastal experience in one of the most coveted locations on 30A.Unmatched Location & Private Outdoor SpacesEnjoy the convenience of a private driveway with parking for two vehicles, just steps from the beach access at Savannah Pavilion. One of the beachfront lots has been transformed into your own private seaside park, complete with a sandy footpath leading to an intimate beachfront seating area with two Adirondack chairs—the perfect place to savor morning coffee or sunset cocktails with uninterrupted Gulf views.First-Floor Bedrooms Designed for ComfortThe first level features three thoughtfully appointed bedrooms, ideal for families or groups.The King Primary Suite offers new designer furnishings, a large flat-screen TV, and a beautifully renovated ensuite bathroom with dual marble vanities and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.A Queen Bedroom with ample storage shares a renovated hall bath featuring a single vanity and tub/shower combination.The third bedroom includes two twin beds, perfect for kids or additional guests, and shares the same hall bath.Both the king and queen bedrooms open onto a screened-in rear porch with rocking chairs, creating a peaceful space to relax while listening to the waves.Gulf-View Living on the Second FloorUpstairs, natural light and sweeping Gulf views fill the open living spaces. The recently renovated kitchen features a breakfast bar for two, a built-in desk for remote work, and everything needed for preparing meals at home. A nearby half bath adds convenience for guests.The dining area comfortably seats six and flows seamlessly into the living room, furnished with new designer pieces, a large flat-screen TV, and additional club seating—ideal for family dinners, game nights, or winding down after a beach day. Step outside to the beachfront open-air porch, where bar-top Adirondack seating for four offers front-row views of sunrises, sunsets, and the Gulf breeze.Rooftop Tower with 360-Degree ViewsCrowning the home is a third-floor enclosed glass tower and expansive wrap-around rooftop deck with unobstructed views of the Gulf and Seaside in every direction. Outfitted with Adirondack bar seating, this rooftop oasis is one of the best vantage points in all of Seaside—perfect for watching Fourth of July and New Year’s Eve fireworks from the comfort and privacy of your own beachfront retreat.Savannah Sands is a rare Seaside vacation rental that combines luxury, privacy, and unbeatable beachfront views—an unforgettable destination for your next stay on Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A.* 5 night minimum in Summer, Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 1,670 square feet1-minute walk, 79 feet to beach access at Savannah Pavilion; largest private beaches on 30APrivate driveway parking for two vehiclesSituated on two beachfront lotsFull size washer and dryer in homePeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), along with a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002142
